thread:
elena: Heads up — after the 03/20 deploy we're seeing intermittent 5xx on /v1/embeddings (tail). Looks like a KV cache key collision in the new image. Need an expedited hotpatch and approval to pull forward. @ops-oncall

ops-oncall: Oncall acked. Share proposed image and rollback plan pls.

sam: Proposed fix is a small change to key hashing + TTL bump. Built image: r2026-03-20-kvhash1. Quick plan: pin, staged canary -> 20% -> 100% if healthy. Auto-rollback threshold: errors > 3% sustained 3m. Smoke test ready.

raj: Need explicit fallback image and an added circuit-breaker config. Fallback: r2026-03-19-stable. Circuit-breaker: 1.2s timeout and 4 concurrent request cap. Approve if those are set.

elena: I'll kick off the rollout once the deploy command is approved. Deploy command (dry):
```
./deploy --service embeddings --image r2026-03-20-kvhash1 --canary 20 --note "kv key collision fix"
```
Also adding a verbose smoke script to the incident ticket.

katie: SRE gives emergency thumbs up. I'll wire alerts to the incident and add a short dashboard comparison of p50/p95/p99. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Received deploy request. Validating image and manifests...

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary rollout start: r2026-03-20-kvhash1 -> 20% @1792480035

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Canary metrics @20%: errors 1.1% (down from 6.3%), latency p95 1.1s.

sam: Good sign. Running canary smoke: `curl -fsS https://api/embeddings/v1/health || exit 1` all green.

ops-oncall: Monitoring. If errors exceed 3% or error budget burn > 50% in 5m we revert. Also logging to INC-3490.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Rolling to 50% @1792480060

raj: Reminder: pin traffic allocation in route config so we can quickly rollback to r2026-03-19-stable without route collision.

deploy-bot: [deploybot] Rollout to 100% complete @1792480095. No automated rollback triggered.

elena: Deployed — will open PR for release notes: "Fix: embeddings KV cache key hashing to prevent small-batch 5xx". Adding post-deploy checks to incident.

katie: Adding postmortem checklist: reproduce locally, verify cache invariants, run load test at 2x baseline. Tagging docs and product.

ops-oncall: Closing loop from oncall. Leave incident open 24h for regression watch. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
